function.description: Propose a setting change to the OWNER as a one-tap card (owner turn only). An operator-only setting is filed for the operator and you get its id. It also makes someone a room admin or grants a room a tool. Not for money (propose_action).
function.name: propose_setting

command.description: The owner's line: `/mcp add <id> <https-url>`, `/config set <key> <value>`, `/goal grant <id> tools=a,b`, `/job edit <id> grant tools=a,b`, `/model <name> default`, `/groups role telegram _<chat_id> <uid> <admin|blocked|member>` or `/groups tools telegram _<chat_id> [admin] add|remove <name>`.
